name: @sos-2/autonomy-runtime
description: SOS 2.0 Autonomy Runtime (Work Order P12): the body-lease supervision and recovery layer that keeps long-running work alive while bodies are disposable. Lease lifecycle transitions flow THROUGH the P9 action-gateway body-lifecycle family with action-time authority re-evaluation (a revoked authority stops execution — pinned). Worker heartbeats are an injectable BeatSource: a missed-beat window transitions a lease to SUSPECTED (truthful UNKNOWN — the body may be alive; death is never fabricated) and ONLY a verified failure observation transitions to LOST (pinned: suspected != lost). On LOST the RecoveryPlanner re-plans — which tasks the replacement body inherits, which checkpoints it resumes from, which authority context carries over, and what stays honestly UNKNOWN until re-verified. Provider outages are typed windows with truthful UNAVAILABLE statuses (never silent retry storms); recovery follows bounded backoff with typed retry records, then ASK when bounds are exhausted. Every lease, retry and recovery episode appends to the task's durable cost record — accounting is evidence, never an enforcement authority. Provider-neutral contracts + deterministic reference implementations (injectable seams, offline-testable); real providers attach later as adapters without contract change; honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED for real endpoints. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers in this package's src — the clock, beat source, stores and sinks are injected.
